analytical_expectation.fidelity_note: screening expectation is a distinct fixture model; disagreement is reported and cannot silently change gates
analytical_expectation.role: supporting truth, not replacement for numerical gates

endpoints.equivalent_state_rule: No mesh comparison until all grids complete and satisfy every required per-grid evidence category at comparable late-time windows.

field_stationarity.metric: deterministic late-window step-to-step field differences plus declared monitors

flow_outer_settling.metric: volume-weighted normalized RMS and q95 direct outer-to-outer update
flow_outer_settling.normalization: field RMS with SMALL floor, as qualified telemetry definition
flow_outer_settling.tail_statistic: tail20 maximum normalized RMS <= 0.01 and q95 <= 0.01 for each required field; no positive late-tail trend

acceptance.temperature_continuity: PASS or NOT_ESTABLISHED with explicit evidence

interface.cold_solid: integrated signed heat rate from retained interface fields/post-processing
interface.hot_solid: integrated signed heat rate from retained interface fields/post-processing

local_field_stationarity.reason: historical R2/R6 localized unresolved transverse flow and pressure behavior at the inlet manifold
local_field_stationarity.region: inlet-manifold / core-entry region defined by x <= 0.05 m in shell/tube fields

mesh_independence.equivalent_state_rule: compare only after all three grids independently pass the per-grid profile evidence

declared_quantities: shell/tube inlet and outlet mass flux

property_validity.extrapolation_policy: no silent extrapolation; any field outside declared range is FAIL
property_validity.source: OpenFOAM Foundation v10 constant-property water/aluminum qualification fixture
property_validity.version: Foundation v10 case dictionaries; water rho=1000 kg/m3, Cp=4181 J/kg/K, mu=959e-6 Pa s, Pr=6.62

source.basis: clean copies of retained HX-CFD-QUAL-01 Rev A coarse/medium/fine source cases

stop_logic: required per-grid gate FAIL/NOT_ESTABLISHED -> no mesh comparison disposition PASS

thermal_outer_settling.metric: volume-weighted normalized RMS and q95 direct outer-to-outer update
thermal_outer_settling.normalization: field RMS with SMALL floor, same definition for all grids
thermal_outer_settling.tail_statistic: tail20 maximum normalized RMS <= 0.01 and q95 <= 0.01 for each available required field
